findings.title: Scalar finalization shortcut skips retained index-owner history
findings.description: The new scalar/visible-expression gate bypasses NumeratorInterface::translate even when a scalar zero retains contracted indices. Generated finalization reorders provisional outgoing edge 0 to final edge 1 but leaves the scalar zero history at edge(0,1). Correct explicit transport records edge(1,1). A subsequent multiplication by a vector carrying edge(1,1) is wrongly accepted; the correctly transported zero rejects the third index occurrence. The same closure handles vertex/edge fragments, explicit aggregates, prefactors and projectors.
findings.fix: Gate any fast path on the retained metadata as well as visible payload, or run the existing NumeratorInterface::translate for every generated tensor. Add a finalization regression covering closed scalar zero history and collision behavior after a nonidentity edge/half-edge map.
